result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one awkward content badge and one layout clipping issue near the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: A restaurant card shows a discount badge labeled "-0%", which looks incorrect and visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Replace it with a valid promotion label or hide the badge when there is no discount.

issues.description: The next restaurant card is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, making the lower content feel clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add more bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the fixed nav so cards are fully visible above it.
